notes: לִקְרַאת is split rather than fused because the ASV spends to on the preposition and meet on the construct noun, exactly as rule 30 reads לִפְנֵי → to meet.
Both articles before king Ahaz are unrepresented, the ASV writing the title anarthrously.
The suffix of תַּבְנִיתוֹ takes the whole of it under rule 19's pronominal-rectum sentence, headed on the pronoun.
